description: Bunny.net CLI - storage deploy, CDN purge, full resource management.

commands.name: manifest
commands.summary: Print the bunny-tools command registry as JSON.
commands.description: Outputs the canonical command registry. AI agents and tooling read this to discover commands without parsing prose. Use --pretty for indented output.

flags.name: pretty
flags.description: Indent the JSON output for readability.

flags.name: names
flags.description: Emit one active command name per line (rc.10).

mcp.description: Returns the full bunny-tools registry as JSON.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Initialize bunny.json + creds. Auth → feature multi-select → per-feature config.

flags.name: non-interactive
flags.description: Skip prompts and accept all values via flags.

flags.name: api-key
flags.description: Bunny API key (skipped if env/keychain has one).

flags.name: storage-zone
flags.description: Storage zone name (required for `storage` feature in non-interactive).

flags.name: storage-password
flags.description: Explicit storage zone password (optional; fetched with the API key otherwise).

flags.name: pull-zone
flags.description: Pull zone id for CDN purge.

mcp.description: Initialize a bunny.json (and creds if not set). Non-interactive shape.

commands.name: configure
commands.summary: Store your Bunny API key for a profile (zone passwords are then fetched automatically).

flags.name: non-interactive
flags.description: Skip prompts; accept all values via flags.

flags.name: storage-zone
flags.description: Pin an explicit password for this zone (with --storage-password). Rarely needed.

flags.name: storage-password
flags.description: Explicit storage zone password (optional; fetched automatically otherwise).

commands.name: configure list
commands.summary: List all credential profiles + stored scopes (masked). Active profile marked with *.

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit JSON instead of a table.

commands.name: configure switch
commands.summary: Set the active credential profile.

commands.name: configure remove
commands.summary: Remove a credential profile (entire) or a single scope within it.

flags.name: scope
flags.description: Remove only this scope (e.g. storage:my-app); else removes whole profile.

commands.name: use
commands.summary: Switch active alias from .bunnyrc; with no arg, list aliases.

flags.name: list
flags.description: List aliases (default when no arg given).

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit JSON instead of a table.

commands.name: deploy
commands.summary: Sync public dir to storage zone and purge CDN cache.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Plan and report without mutating remote.

flags.name: delete
flags.description: Delete orphan files on the remote.

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit JSON summary instead of a table.

flags.name: verbose
flags.description: Print Content-Type + size per file and full orphan list.

commands.name: purge
commands.summary: Purge CDN cache: URLs, a whole pull zone, or one Cache-Tag.
commands.description: With URLs, purges each URL. With --pull-zone, purges the whole zone (or only --tag). With no arguments, purges every pull zone listed in bunny.json.

flags.name: pull-zone
flags.description: Pull zone name or id to purge.

examples.description: Purge the pull zones configured in bunny.json.

commands.name: storage ls
commands.summary: List storage zones (no argument) or files at <zone>/<path>.
commands.description: With no argument, lists every storage zone on the account. With `<zone>` or `<zone>/<path>`, lists that directory. Only the account API key is needed: zone passwords are fetched automatically.

flags.name: recursive
flags.description: List every file below the path.

commands.name: storage upload
commands.summary: Upload a local file to <zone>/<path>.

args.name: target
args.description: <zone>/<path>. A trailing slash keeps the local file name.

examples.description: Upload into a directory, keeping the name.

commands.name: storage download
commands.summary: Download <zone>/<path> to a local file.

args.name: local
args.description: Local destination (default: remote file name in cwd).

commands.name: storage rm
commands.summary: Delete a file (or a directory with -r) at <zone>/<path>.

flags.name: recursive
flags.description: Delete every file below the path.

commands.name: storage sync
commands.summary: Upload a local directory to <zone>[/<path>] (upload-only, no CDN purge).

commands.name: storage zone list
commands.summary: List storage zones with id, region, size and replication.

commands.name: storage zone get
commands.summary: Show one storage zone as JSON (passwords stripped).

commands.name: storage zone create
commands.summary: Create a storage zone.

examples.command: bunny storage zone create my-zone --region sg

commands.name: storage zone update
commands.summary: Update a storage zone with a raw JSON body.

commands.name: storage zone delete
commands.summary: Delete a storage zone and all its files.

commands.name: cdn list
commands.summary: List pull zones.

commands.name: cdn get
commands.summary: Show one pull zone as JSON.

commands.name: cdn create
commands.summary: Create a pull zone in front of an origin URL.

commands.name: cdn update
commands.summary: Update a pull zone with a raw JSON body.

commands.name: cdn delete
commands.summary: Delete a pull zone.

commands.name: cdn rule list
commands.summary: List edge rules on a pull zone.

commands.name: cdn rule add
commands.summary: Add or update an edge rule (raw JSON rule; include Guid to update).

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit JSON result (rules after the change).

commands.name: cdn rule delete
commands.summary: Delete an edge rule by Guid.

args.name: guid
args.description: Edge rule Guid (see `bunny cdn rule list`).

commands.name: cdn hostname list
commands.summary: List custom hostnames linked to a pull zone.

commands.name: cdn hostname add
commands.summary: Link a hostname, provision a Let's Encrypt cert and enable ForceSSL. Idempotent.

flags.name: no-force-ssl
flags.description: Provision cert but disable HTTP→HTTPS redirect (re-run flips it off).

examples.command: bunny cdn hostname add my-site cdn.example.com
bunny cdn hostname add my-site cdn.example.com --no-force-ssl

commands.name: cdn hostname remove
commands.summary: Unlink a custom hostname from a pull zone.

commands.name: domain connect
commands.summary: One step: link hostname + cert + optional apex PULLZONE DNS record. Idempotent.

flags.name: dns-zone
flags.description: Also create the PULLZONE DNS record in this DNS zone (domain or id).

flags.name: name
flags.description: DNS record name when --dns-zone is given. Empty/`@` for apex (default).

flags.name: no-wait
flags.description: Skip waiting for the cert (caller verifies separately).

examples.command: bunny domain connect my-site example.com --dns-zone example.com
examples.description: Link, cert and apex DNS in one go.

commands.name: dns list
commands.summary: List DNS zones.

commands.name: dns get
commands.summary: Show one DNS zone (with records) as JSON.

commands.name: dns create
commands.summary: Create a DNS zone for a domain.

commands.name: dns delete
commands.summary: Delete a DNS zone and all its records.

commands.name: dns record list
commands.summary: List records in a DNS zone.

examples.command: bunny dns record list example.com --type A

commands.name: dns record add
commands.summary: Add a DNS record (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, REDIRECT, PULLZONE, SRV, CAA, PTR, SCRIPT, NS).

args.name: name
args.description: Record name (`@` or empty for apex).

flags.name: pull-zone
flags.description: PULLZONE shortcut: pull zone name or id; fills value + link-name.

examples.command: bunny dns record add example.com A www 1.2.3.4
bunny dns record add example.com REDIRECT www https://example.com
bunny dns record add example.com PULLZONE @ --pull-zone my-site
examples.description: Point the apex at a pull zone.

commands.name: dns record update
commands.summary: Update a DNS record with a raw JSON body.

commands.name: dns record delete
commands.summary: Delete a DNS record.

commands.name: stream library list
commands.summary: List Stream video libraries.

commands.name: stream library create
commands.summary: Create a Stream video library.

commands.name: stream library delete
commands.summary: Delete a Stream video library.

commands.name: stream video list
commands.summary: List videos in a library.

commands.name: stream video upload
commands.summary: Upload a video file to a library.

commands.name: stream video delete
commands.summary: Delete a video.

commands.name: containers list
commands.summary: List Magic Containers apps.

commands.name: containers create
commands.summary: Create a Magic Containers app.

commands.name: containers delete
commands.summary: Delete a Magic Containers app.

commands.name: scripting list
commands.summary: List edge scripts.

commands.name: scripting deploy
commands.summary: Deploy an edge script from a file (updates the script with that name, else creates it).

commands.name: scripting delete
commands.summary: Delete an edge script.

commands.name: install mcp
commands.summary: Register bunny-tools as an MCP server in Claude Code (one-shot bootstrap).

flags.name: scope
flags.description: MCP scope: user | project | local (default: user).

examples.description: Add bunny-tools to Claude's user-scope MCP config.
Add to the current project's .claude config.

commands.name: update
commands.summary: Self-update bunny-tools to the latest version on npm.

commands.name: mcp
commands.summary: Boot the bunny-tools MCP stdio server (for AI agents).

examples.command: claude mcp add bunny-tools -- npx -y bunny-tools mcp

commands.name: whoami
commands.summary: Show the current account context (stored credentials + reachable zone counts).

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit JSON instead of a table.

examples.description: Quick "am I authenticated and which account?" check.
Inspect a specific profile without switching.

commands.name: docs
commands.summary: Open Bunny.net docs in the browser. Optional [topic] for direct deep links.

args.name: topic
args.description: Topic shortcut (e.g. storage, cdn, dns) or path slug.
